tex_content.html:
Lemma
[Restriction to an open set preserves the differential]

↗ lem:opens-inclusion-differential

Let $F\colon M\to M'$ be smooth, $U\subseteq M$ open, and $x\in U$. Then \[ d(F|_U)_x=dF_x. \]

Proof

↗ lem:opens-inclusion-differential \sketch Write $F|_U=F\circ \iota $ and use the chain rule together with $d\iota _x=\operatorname {id}$.

□
